outcome: Timing of accidental death (before vs. after childbirth)
cohort: Pregnant women and women who died during pregnancy and puerperium from 2009 to 2019 in Hunan Province, China
finding: The study found a higher accidental mortality rate in rural areas compared to urban areas, with suicide and traffic accidents being the leading causes of accidental maternal death.
mod_finding: 49.2% of pregnant women who died from accidental causes gave birth by caesarean section.
